description: This file defines the TenantClient interface for interacting with Hono's Tenant API, including methods for retrieving tenant configuration information based on tenant ID and subject DN, with optional support for OpenTracing span contexts.

classes.name: TenantClient
classes.description: An interface for accessing Tenant API functionalities within Hono, providing methods to get tenant information by ID or certificate subject DN.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves tenant configuration information asynchronously for a specified tenant ID, returning a Future of TenantObject.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Default method that retrieves tenant information with a given tenant ID, using the current span context.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves tenant configuration based on the subject DN of a trusted certificate authority, returning a Future of TenantObject.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Default method that retrieves tenant information based on subject DN with a provided span context.
